rules.name: Faction-Weighted Selection
rules.description: Missions from a faction with high reputation (>4) appear 80% more often

rules.name: Zone-Restricted Run
rules.description: Once a player picks a zone, all missions come from that zone for the run

rules.name: Time-of-Day Variation
rules.description: Day vs night missions vary by in-game hour

rules.name: Post-Boss Cooldown
rules.description: After defeating a boss, no boss-zone missions for 2 runs

rules.name: Character-Locked Missions
rules.description: Each character has 5-10 signature missions that only spawn for them

rules.name: Random Event Trigger
rules.description: 1-in-20 chance to trigger a special event mission

rules.name: Seasonal Mission Adjustment
rules.description: Season changes (every 10 in-game days) shift faction weightings

rules.name: Difficulty Spike Recovery
rules.description: After 3 consecutive failures, spawn 1 easy mission

rules.name: Chain-Unlocked Bonus
rules.description: After completing a chain, related faction missions appear more often

rules.name: Reputation Gate
rules.description: Tier 5+ reputation unlocks elite faction missions

rules.name: Construct-Aware Selection
rules.description: If player has unlocked a construct, missions involving that construct appear more often

rules.name: Fixer-Match Bonus
rules.description: Missions from recently-used fixer appear 30% more often for 3 runs

rules.name: Deck Synergy Boost
rules.description: Missions matching deck archetypes get 20% boost

rules.name: Chain Failure Recovery
rules.description: After chain failure, salvage missions appear (reduced rewards)

rules.name: Construct Loss Buff
rules.description: After construct loss, recovery missions appear with bonus rewards

rules.name: Salvage Spree
rules.description: After 3+ high-credit salvages, mission credit rewards increase 25%

rules.name: Hour-Cycle Pattern
rules.description: Within a run, missions shift from investigation to defense to extraction as hours progress

rules.name: Completion Bonus Streak
rules.description: 10+ consecutive mission completions trigger bonus missions
